purpose: Single load point for the Branch-B Japanese land system after the v047 vehicle/armor correction and the v048 Bengal/Arakan event-local execution.

land_system_layers.rule: Trace first-line combat fraction, cadre, fatigue, command succession, reserves and medical support. Construction/support personnel are not infantry.
Trace weapon presence, crew, observation, registration, ammunition survival, lot/QC and suppression. No global artillery multiplier.
Trace warning time, labor, material, engineer plant, dispersion, protected magazines and physical survival under bombardment.
Trace wire/radio/battery/spares/test gear and physical survival; better hardware serviceability does not create more sets.
Trace type/count/serviceability/terrain/fuel/recovery. Branch vehicles can differ in reliability and return-to-service without changing gun/armor class.
Trace trucks, tractors, landing craft, pumps, generators, stores, water and routes. Throughput acts before combat readiness, not as lethality.
All gains remain vulnerable to air/naval/artillery suppression, armor, engineers, isolation and loss of observation.

vehicle_correction_to_v046.old_compression: v046 represented local armor mainly as +5-10% vehicle serviceability and left historically trace-valid hardware otherwise unchanged.
vehicle_correction_to_v046.new_rule: Vehicle families remain historically recognizable but are Branch-specific production/service variants. Use type-specific running-gear, powertrain, maintenance, recovery and reappearance deltas; never collapse them into one uptime number.
vehicle_correction_to_v046.quantity_guard: No new vehicle count is created. Quantity and allocation require a dated OOB/ledger.
vehicle_correction_to_v046.performance_guard: No armor, gun energy, crew ergonomics or radio quantity improves without its own design and fielding trace.

event_sequence: only then calculate personnel casualties and operational timing

executed_event_local_adjustments.GALVANIC: Tarawa ground node reclosed in v047; naval, air and submarine nodes unchanged.

BENGAL_ARAKAN.result_guard: Chittagong capture, British demolitions, field-army escape and Feni-Comilla stalemate retained.
BENGAL_ARAKAN.vehicle_guard: No Japanese tank regiment and no centered combat-tank credit; gains arise only from traced transport, prime movers, engineer plant, repair and recovery.
BENGAL_ARAKAN.year_end_delta: Approximately 300-600 additional effective Japanese personnel and 20-45 additional dispatchable vehicles versus the v047-implied state.

hard_guards: No universal armor or tank survivability multiplier.
No automatic increase in tank, truck, tractor, radio, gun or manpower count.
No 72h reappearance after catastrophic destruction, drowning, abandonment or workshop loss.
Do not double-count process improvements already embedded in an event's serviceable starting state.
